proof_summary: Take the admissible value \(n=51\), giving index \(7044\). Modular computation shows \(2^{7044}+2\equiv672\pmod{1398}\), \(2^{1398}\equiv1\pmod{1399}\), and \(2^{672}+3\equiv0\pmod{1399}\), so \(1399\) divides the relevant number and its smallest prime factor is at most \(1399<1669\).
